component.name: IMGo
component.summary: Batch image compression and conversion, processed locally

description.p: This is a community package of IMGo: it repackages the official upstream Debian build unmodified, fetched from upstream's releases at install time.
IMGo is a batch image compression and conversion tool. Process multiple images at once, adjust quality and dimensions, and convert between common formats without uploading your files.

ul.li: Batch compression and conversion of JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF and HEIC images
JPEG XL (JXL) output in the desktop app
Animated PNG, GIF, WebP and AVIF output
Quality, lossless, resize and metadata controls
Everything runs locally; images never leave the device

description.p: A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Process images in your Pictures folder without picking them through the file chooser: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-pictures com.meowtec.imgo
Process images in your Downloads folder without picking them through the file chooser: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-download com.meowtec.imgo
The whole home directory, as upstream's own Flatpak grants: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home com.meowtec.imgo
Undo all of these: flatpak override --user --reset com.meowtec.imgo
